title: ProCom: A Few-shot Targeted Community Detection Algorithm

problem.claim: Targeted community detection seeks to distinguish a particular type of community in a network.

gap.claim: Traditional methods do not capture targeted-community features, while semi-supervised methods have limited adaptability and require substantial labeled data, domain knowledge, and manual effort.

narrative_sequence.summary: Defines targeted community detection as distinguishing a particular community type in a network.
Motivates the task through real-world applications such as identifying fraud groups in transaction networks.
Identifies limitations of traditional and semi-supervised community detection methods.

unknowns: The proposed method and its mechanism are not described.
No explicit contribution or novelty claim is provided.
No experiments, datasets, baselines, metrics, or results are provided.
No evidence of adaptability beyond the stated problem motivation is provided.
